 ## Errors
 
 `RpcError` is `#[non_exhaustive]`: keep a wildcard arm when matching on it.
+
+## Retries
+
+`send` retries a request that timed out, up to 3 attempts in total, waiting 200 ms before the second attempt
+and doubling the wait each time (at most 4 s, plus jitter). After the last attempt it returns
+`RpcError::Exhausted`.

-- `send` sends a request and returns the first answer or error.

+- `send` sends a request; a request that times out is sent again, up to 3 attempts in total.
 
 ## Timeouts
 
-A request that gets no answer within the timeout fails with `RpcError::Timeout`.
+A request that gets no answer within the timeout is retried with exponential backoff. When no attempt is
+left, the call fails with `RpcError::Exhausted { attempts }`.
